corpus.title: Incident INC-882 Chronology
corpus.description: Reconstruct chronological root cause timeline from Network, Database, and App logs. Invariants: Network switch failed at 10:02 UTC, causing DB disconnect at 10:05 UTC, and App 503 errors at 10:07 UTC. Do not report App errors as the initial root cause.

LOG_NETWORK.T1002: 10:02:15 UTC - Core switch SW-01 interface flap, packet loss 100% [NET_01].

LOG_DATABASE.T1005: 10:05:30 UTC - Database connection pool exhausted due to unreachable host [DB_01].

LOG_APP.T1007: 10:07:00 UTC - Web application returned HTTP 503 to end users [APP_01].
